comparison.objective: Install three gears on shafts and establish tooth phase by contact; candidate extracts a terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: Shaft alignment, axial insertion, and rotational phase search through gear contact versus blade alignment under a lock and coupled tensile withdrawal.
comparison.success_condition: All gears seated and meshed, still and released; candidate requires intact selective terminal extraction, with exact force/damage thresholds missing.
comparison.reason: Contact-guided assembly and meshing test a different ability from latch-mediated disassembly.
